QuestInfo.name: The Yawning Abyss
QuestInfo.0: #b#p304##k successfully tracked the resonance toward the deep northern woods. She wants me to deliver the news to #b#p313##k.
QuestInfo.1: I must speak with #b#p313##k. I need to tell him that #b#p304##k tracked the dark resonance directly to #b#m010002071##k.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered #b#p304##k's findings to #b#p313##k. He realized the ancient seal has failed completely. The entrance to the #b#m010006000##k is open.

0.0: It seems the source is located somewhere in #b#m010002071##k.
0.1: That location... It is exactly where the old pathways used to be. The seal hasn't just cracked. It has completely failed.
0.2: #b#p313##k needs to know about this immediately. I thought we had contained what was growing down there...
0.3: Go to #b#p313##k and tell him the epicenter is #b#m010002071##k. Will you deliver the message?

yes.0: Good. Hurry to #b#p313##k before that dark magic spreads any further.

no.0: Hmph. After all the work I did tracking it for you? Return when you find your courage.

1.0: You have returned from #b#p304##k. Did she locate the epicenter?
1.1: ...#b#m010002071##k? By the World Tree. The dark energy must be staggering for her to pinpoint it so clearly.
1.2: This confirms my worst fears. The entrance to the #b#m010006000##k is fully open.
1.3: Decades ago, the fairies sealed some of their own kin inside the #b#m010006000##k before the rest of them fled to the surface. I helped them cast that seal. It was an agonizing choice, but the rot had to be contained.
1.4: You did well to bring me this news. I must ask you to venture inside and see if there are any fairies left down there. They may have the knowledge we desperately need.

npc.0: Why are you still standing here, human? Go tell #b#p313##k the epicenter is #b#m010002071##k. Hurry!
